The lens has a front cap on it.
The camera is held by a person's hand in all photos.

No photo shows the camera powered on or taking a picture.

claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The lens may have fungus or scratches on the glass.
risks.proof: A photo of the lens glass without the cap.

risks.risk: The shutter count may be higher than claimed.
risks.proof: A photo of the shutter count display on the LCD screen.
risks.if_unproven: as having a high shutter count

risks.risk: The battery may be dead or the charger may not work.
risks.proof: A video showing the camera powering on with the battery and charger connected.

proof_requests: Video of the camera powering on and taking a photo.
Photo of the lens glass without the cap.
Photo of the shutter count on the LCD screen.
Video of the battery and charger being used to power the camera.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
